Companion Animal Travel Desk Notice

Travelers need to check their pet travel details early so we can help keep every trip smooth and calm. Our team is here to make the process easier and to keep you and your companion moving with less stress.

Please make sure carriers are tidy, secure, and ready for handover before you reach the desk. The ground team treats each case with care and moves every carrier between services as part of a shared effort. <<FACT F078>> Bring any needed documents, and keep your pet settled and easy to handle while you wait.

For bird travel, please follow the allowed weight limit for the pet and crate together. <<FACT F065>> If anything looks uncertain, come by and speak with us before boarding so we can guide you kindly and quickly.

Please visit the Companion Animal Travel Desk for help before you head to departure.
